---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
author: "Nicholas Tison"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month)
```

```{r}
summary(mallards$speed)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  group_by(season, month) |>
  summarize(mean_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = month)) +
  geom_density_ridges()
```
